description: highly detailed HD pixel art with painterly shading and layered depth, a cinematic wide establishing shot for a trucking tycoon game: Los Angeles with downtown towers, the Hollywood sign on the hills, palms and the port cranes of Long Beach, its real skyline rising in the middle distance with every landmark clearly recognisable, seen from above a busy interstate in the foreground where American long-nose conventional semi tractors with long hoods, chrome grilles and sleeper cabs pull white trailers, never a flat-faced European cab-over truck, a blank green overhead highway sign, the city's own surroundings and water or hills beyond, a bright clear day around noon, a deep blue sky with a few small white clouds, crisp sunlight with short shadows, lively natural colours, no text, lettering, words, labels or logos anywhere
